description: The times a network member has free to meet in the next 1 to 7 days, the same times their booking page shows, each with their UTC offset, plus the meeting length, where it happens and book_url. This server does not book: give the person book_url so they pick a time and book it themselves. A member who does not take bookings here gets taking_bookings false and the public ways to reach them.

days.description: How many days ahead to look, from now.
